dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, who's that on your screen? She's beautiful!
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ˈhuːz ˈðæt ɑːn jʊr ˈskriːn? ʃiːz ˈbjuːtəfəl!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: It's Audrey Hepburn. I'm writing a short biography of her for Mr. Brown.
dialogue.reading: ɪts ˈɔːdri ˈhɛpbɜːrn. aɪm ˈraɪtɪŋ ə ˈʃɔːrt baɪˈɑːɡrəfi əv hɜːr fər ˈmɪstər ˈbraʊn.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Oh, I love her old movies. When did she become famous?
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ, aɪ ˈlʌv hɜːr ˈoʊld ˈmuːviz. ˈwɛn dɪd ʃiː bɪˈkʌm ˈfeɪməs?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: In her twenties. At the age of twenty-four, she won an Oscar.
dialogue.reading: ɪn hɜːr ˈtwɛntiz. ət ði ˈeɪdʒ əv ˈtwɛnti ˈfɔːr, ʃiː ˈwʌn ən ˈɑːskər.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: That's young! What did she do before that?
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈjʌŋ! ˈwʌt dɪd ʃiː ˈduː bɪˈfɔːr ˈðæt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: She studied dance. As a child, she was often hungry because there wasn't enough food.
dialogue.reading: ʃiː ˈstʌdid ˈdæns. əz ə ˈtʃaɪld, ʃiː wʌz ˈɔːfən ˈhʌŋɡri bɪˈkɔːz ðɛr ˈwʌzənt ɪˈnʌf ˈfuːd.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: That's sad. Did she make movies all her life?
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈsæd. dɪd ʃiː ˈmeɪk ˈmuːviz ˈɔːl hɜːr ˈlaɪf?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No. Later on, she worked for UNICEF and helped children in poor countries.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ. ˈleɪtər ɑːn, ʃiː ˈwɜːrkt fər ˈjuːnɪsɛf ənd ˈhɛlpt ˈtʃɪldrən ɪn ˈpʊr ˈkʌntriz.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: I didn't know that. How many movies did she make in her lifetime?
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈdɪdənt ˈnoʊ ˈðæt. ˈhaʊ ˈmɛni ˈmuːviz dɪd ʃiː ˈmeɪk ɪn hɜːr ˈlaɪftaɪm?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: About thirty. But many people remember her for her work with children.
dialogue.reading: əˈbaʊt ˈθɜːrti. bʌt ˈmɛni ˈpiːpəl rɪˈmɛmbər hɜːr fər hɜːr ˈwɜːrk wɪð ˈtʃɪldrən.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: In 1993, at the age of sixty-three.
dialogue.reading: ɪn ˈnaɪntiːn ˈnaɪnti ˈθriː, ət ði ˈeɪdʒ əv ˈsɪksti ˈθriː.
